queryPath.description: Path to the named query this binding will execute

mode.description: The path mode in which the query binding will operate. Two modes: Direct and Expression. See documentation for details.

returnFormat.description: The format to use for the results of the query execution

parameters.description: Parameter values to be passed to the query. Values are expressions.

enabled.description: If true, the query will polled: that is, executed repeatedly at an interval. If false, the query will only run once on startup and again as parameter values change.

rate.description: The rate at which the query will be executed. If numeric, this rate will be interpreted as the number of seconds between executions. If a string, the string will be interpreted as an expression whose result will be the poll rate. If the rate is not positive, polling will be disabled.

designerUseLimit.description: If true, this query will use the query's limit settings when executed in the designer.

bypassCache.description: If true, this binding will bypass the query's cache built-in result cache.
